senses.gloss: m.(b. h.; גלל)heap of stones, bones &c., esp. rubbish, ruins.
units: <cite ref="Mishnah Sotah 9:2">Sot. IX, 2</cite> if the body of a murdered person was found <he>טמון בג׳</he> buried in a heap.
<cite ref="Ketubot 15b:2">Keth. 15ᵇ</cite> <he>לפקח עליו את הג׳</he> as to removing debris for saving one’s life (on the Sabbath).

<cite ref="Shabbat 34a:2">Sabb. 34ᵃ</cite> <he>עשהו ג׳ של עצמות</he> changed him into a heap of bones; a. fr.—Pl. <cite ref="C00951"><he>גַּלִּים</he></cite>, <cite ref="C00929"><he>גַּלִּין</he></cite>.
<cite ref="Mishnah Kilayim 1:2">Kil. I, 2</cite>, v. <cite ref="H00572"><he>חֲזֶרֶת</he></cite>. Cmp. <cite ref="C00719"><he>גִּילָּא</he></cite>.
<cite ref="Mishnah Mikvaot 5:6">Mikv. V, 6</cite> <he>ג׳ שנתלש</he> a wave thrown on shore.
<cite ref="Shemot Rabbah 19:7">Ex. R. s. 19</cite> <he>הגיעוה ג׳</he> waves overcame her, i.e. she encountered storms; a. e.

senses.gloss: revolving door, turning on hinges or pivots.
units: <cite ref="Shabbat 81a:2">Sabb. 81ᵃ</cite> <he>של ג׳</he> the pivot of a revolving door. V. <cite ref="C00883"><he>גִּלָּה</he></cite>.

senses.gloss: (v. LXX Hos. XII, 12) turtoise. Pl. as above. Sifra Sh’mini, ch. IV, Par. 3.
